Tidy tables from a subgroup result

Source: R/stats_subgroups.R
as.data.frame.idiographic_groups.Rd

Tidy tables from a subgroup result

Usage

# S3 method for class 'idiographic_groups'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("groups", "components", "bic"),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'idiostats_groups'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("groups", "components", "bic"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A find_subgroups() result.

row.names, optional

Ignored.

what

Which table to return: "groups" (one row per person, as groups()), "components" (one row per subgroup and term: the component regressions of method = "mixture_regression", with the mixing share and residual sigma), or "bic" (one row per candidate number of components: the mixture's own BIC sweep, reported when method = "mixture_regression" and k = "auto").

...

Ignored.

Value

A data.frame. "components" has columns subgroup, share, sigma, term, estimate. Requesting "components" or "bic" from a result that has no such table raises an error of class idiographic_missing_table.

Examples

g <- find_subgroups(srl, y = "effort", x = "efficacy:monitoring",
                    id = "name", method = "mixture_regression", k = 2,
                    reps = 5)
as.data.frame(g, what = "components")
#>    subgroup     share    sigma        term   estimate
#> 1        g1 0.3887867 18.25083 (Intercept) 37.6276491
#> 2        g1 0.3887867 18.25083    efficacy  0.1539743
#> 3        g1 0.3887867 18.25083       value  0.1294227
#> 4        g1 0.3887867 18.25083    planning  0.1828805
#> 5        g1 0.3887867 18.25083  monitoring  0.1110485
#> 6        g2 0.6112133 20.66396 (Intercept)  6.8401929
#> 7        g2 0.6112133 20.66396    efficacy  0.2379747
#> 8        g2 0.6112133 20.66396       value  0.1003651
#> 9        g2 0.6112133 20.66396    planning  0.3807770
#> 10       g2 0.6112133 20.66396  monitoring  0.1169605
